name: numéro d'identification national unique (NIN)
issuer: the Ministry of the Interior's automated NIN system, through the civil registers of the communes and consular services
note: Executive Decree 23-316 of 6 September 2023 on the unique national identification number (NIN), Journal officiel no. 60 of 13 September 2023, pp. 4-5, which repealed Executive Decree 10-210 of 16 September 2010; read 2026-11-03 in the Journal officiel's own French edition (until then from Algérie-Eco's report of 22 September 2023). Art. 3: the NIN is given to Algerian citizens born in Algeria or abroad and to foreigners born or present in Algeria, whatever their stay (read as citizens and residents). Art. 4: it is personal, permanent and unchangeable. Art. 5: it is carried on the civil-status registers and extracts kept by the communes and consular services and on identity and travel documents. Art. 6: eighteen digits; for citizens and for foreigners born in Algeria, two positions for sex, the act's mention and birth in Algeria or abroad, three for the last three digits of the year of entry in the birth register, four for the commune or country of that entry, five for the birth act's number, two for the register's serial number by year and two for the control key (so it is built from the birth's registration, read as given at birth); for foreigners present in Algeria, a special three-digit number, a thirteen-digit sequential number and the key. Art. 2: the control key is generated by the automated system; no rule is given (the positions' content is left to an order of the interior minister), so `check` is left out and the pattern draws eighteen digits. Art. 7: an automated system at the Ministry of the Interior generates it; art. 11: government bodies must use it in all administrative procedures. No fee, time, age or purpose term is stated.

sources.title: Journal officiel de la République algérienne n° 60 (13 septembre 2023), pp. 4-5: Décret exécutif n° 23-316 du 6 septembre 2023 relatif au numéro d'identification national unique
sources.said: Art. 3. — Le NIN est attribué aux : — citoyens algériens nés en Algérie ou à l'étranger ; — étrangers nés ou se trouvant en Algérie ; — personnes morales se trouvant en Algérie. Art. 4. — Le NIN est un numéro personnel, permanant, inchangeable et non modifiable ... Art. 5. — Le NIN est porté sur : — les registres et extraits d'état civil tenus au niveau des communes et des services consulaires algériens ... Art. 6. — Le NIN est composé de dix-huit (18) chiffres. ... — deux (2) positions représentant la clé de contrôle. Le contenu des positions du NIN est détaillé par arrêté du ministre chargé de l'intérieur. Art. 7. — Un système automatisé est créé auprès du ministre chargé de l'intérieur, afin de générer le NIN ... Art. 14. — Les dispositions du décret exécutif n° 10-210 du 7 Chaoual 1431 correspondant au 16 septembre 2010 instituant le numéro d'identification national unique, sont abrogées.
